pr.title: Refresh the Projector section of AGENTS.md and the site workflow
pr.head: 359b0d4fcadc9dd0ddb07de6ce58da63076bdeff

summary: This repository uses Projector to record project plans, review pull requests, and publish a review site. This change brings two pieces of generated repository configuration forward: the instructions that sessions follow and the workflow that deploys the site.

Every session now opens pull requests as drafts until a review finds the head clean. The site also deploys when a same-repository pull request closes, so a merged or closed review stops appearing open without waiting for an unrelated deployment.

cards.title: What the review checked
cards.html:
• The review reads both changed files and finds no blocking issue.
  • project check validates the plans. It warns that instruction version 4 is older than version 24 from the installed command.
  • git diff --check passes, and all text outside the Projector markers is unchanged.
  • The close-event deployment needs a real GitHub event after this workflow reaches the default branch.

groups.title: Keep dependent work in drafts until reviewed
groups.kicker: Repository instructions apply the review convention to every session.
intro: AGENTS.md gives sessions the repository’s working rules. The new section tells each session to open pull requests as drafts, including each layer of a stack, which is a series of dependent pull requests. A clean review controls the transition to ready.

For dependent work, the instructions use gh stack to carry a fix from the branch that introduced it into the branches above. Base-branch chaining and merges remain the fallback when that tool is unavailable.

files.note: Adds the draft and dependent-work conventions inside the generated Projector section.

checks.text: Compared the text before and after the Projector markers against the merge base; it is unchanged.
This update targets version 4 of the instructions. The installed Projector command ships version 24, so project check still reports instructions-outdated.

groups.title: Refresh the site when a pull request closes
groups.kicker: A close event deploys the default branch for same-repository work.
intro: The Projector site lists review summaries and each pull request’s state. Its workflow now listens for pull_request_target with the closed activity, which covers both merged pull requests and those closed without merging.

The publish job skips pull requests whose head belongs to another repository. Those fork events also receive a separate concurrency group, so they do not replace a pending deployment in the shared pages group.

files.note: Adds a close-event trigger, skips fork pull requests, and separates their concurrency groups.

checks.text: Traced the site action to actions/checkout with no ref override. GitHub documents that pull_request_target uses the default branch, so this trigger does not execute the pull request’s head.
Read the job condition against same-repository and fork close events: same-repository events publish, and fork events skip.
